sources.title: PDF Memory-Augmented Long Short-Term Memory for Dynamic Video Summarization
sources.snippet: This paper introduces a deep recurrent model, so-called Memory-Augmented LSTM for Dynamic Video Summarization - MALSumm, which integrates two novel recurrent blocks: one for retaining essential information and another for learning new temporal patterns (Figure 1).

sources.title: Memory-Augmented Long Short-Term Memory for Dynamic Video Summarization
sources.snippet: To address these limitations, we propose the Memory-Augmented LSTM for Dynamic Video Summarization - MALSumm, a supervised architecture based on Extended Long Short-Term Memory (xLSTM) networks that enhances memory capacity through a dual-path design.

sources.title: Memory-Augmented Long Short-Term Memory for Dynamic Video Summarization
sources.snippet: The Memory-Augmented LSTM for Dynamic Video Summarization - MALSumm is proposed, a supervised architecture based on Extended Long Short-Term Memory networks that enhances memory capacity through a dual-path design that integrates weighted memory to evaluate local and global information, allowing the model to preserve fine-grained details while maintaining overall temporal consistency.
